scientific_calculator.name: Advanced Scientific Calculator
scientific_calculator.description: Computes any math expression — arithmetic, algebra, calculus, trigonometry, statistics, matrices, and more — and returns the result with step-by-step explanation.

inputFields.label: Expression / Problem
inputFields.description: Any mathematical expression or natural-language problem. Examples: 'sin(45°)', 'integral of x³ from 0 to 2', 'solve x²−5x+6=0', 'eigenvalues of [[1,2],[3,4]]', 'mean of [12,15,9,18,21]', '100!'

inputFields.label: Decimal Precision
inputFields.description: Number of significant figures used in numerical results (default: 10). Increase for more decimal places.

configFields.label: Anthropic API Key
configFields.description: Used to power the interpreter and formatter nodes.

responseFields.label: Result
responseFields.description: The computed answer as a string (numeric, symbolic, list of solutions, matrix, etc.).

responseFields.label: Computation Steps
responseFields.description: Ordered list of intermediate steps taken during computation.

responseFields.label: Explanation
responseFields.description: Human-readable explanation and mathematical context for the result.
